name: Angelic Mastery
body:
You are gifted with at summoning angels at convincing them to serve you.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to Charisma checks made to resolve the effects of planar ally, planar binding or similar spells Additionally, whenever you use a spell to summon an angel, your effective cast level increases by 1 for the purposes of resolving its effects.
